name: BUGLIN BULL RESTAURANT AND SPORTS BAR

violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Cook did not wash hands prior to gloving.
General employee practices. — --Food employee observed eating while preparing food and outside of designated area. - Staff in prep area, staff in server area found eating.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food with bare hands. -Cook on line not wearing gloves while making salad. - Bartender handling lemons with bare hands.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food - Cooked beef found under raw beef in prep cooler under grill. Corrected on site.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --- Sanitizer bucket found at 200ppm CL in pizza making part of the kitchen.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Prep Table on line was not working at time of inspection. Staff had foods in ice, but not enough ice surrounding the foods. Temps found at 45-60F -Front walk-in cooler found at air temp of 49F. Hamburger patties found at 47F. Items moved to basement walk-in cooler or on ice. - Back walk-in cooler found at air temp of 45F. Taco meat found at 57F-sent to landfill. All other items moved to walk-in cooler in basement.

Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. -Fryer found not under hood system due to floor being uneven, Staff is to fix immediately
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Hoods found dirty, blackened and needs deep clean.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --- Wall by fryer that is not under hood system has build up of grease. - Floor in walk-in freezer needs repair raw wood and ice build up. - Floor under fryer needs repair as it tilts and floor is uneven which is why the fryer isn't under the hood.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --- Plastic cups without handles found in seasonings .--Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Napkins on floor in basement.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floor on cook line needs to deep cleaned under equipment. - Walls on cook line need to be cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. - Holes in floor in dish pit.
Cooking and reheating to the proper time and temperature (5 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
